content: Listing the Munāẓara-yi Bazm u Razm as the fourth of four dedicated treatises (after the Suʾl al-Mulūk, the Sharḥ al-Basmala and, earlier in the article, the R. Ḥurūf), MK writes that it, "like the Query of Kings, was written at the request of Bāysunghur" -- stronger language than the dissertation's plain "written for" (CL-0237).
